title: The Actions panel shows 'Duplicate (Shift+C)' disabled with a 'Sandbox only' hint, while the same screen renders the opponent's hand face-up (board.js only does that when isSandboxGame is true) and opponent turns are auto-skipped (turn 1→3→5), i.e. this IS a sandbox/goldfish game.
expected: Screenshot 16.png shows opponent hand face-up (board.js:17 renders face-up only when isSandboxGame is true) while the Actions panel shows Duplicate disabled with "Sandbox only". Source cause: meta-actions.js:224-238 initMetaActions() is a one-shot (guarded by _metaActionsInitialized) that calls renderActionPanel() at DOMContentLoaded, when state.js:108 `let isSandboxGame = false`. lobby.js:395/425 later set isSandboxGame = true but grep shows no caller of renderActionPanel outside meta-actions.js (only setCounterSign at :42 and initMetaActions at :228), so the panel is never re-rendered after the flag flips and stays in the non-sandbox disabled state (meta-actions.js:122,130-133) in a sandbox game.
rule: rule 108.7.c (hand is Private Information) / DESIGN.md Goldfish mode

history.note: setSandboxGame() re-renders the Actions panel on every sandbox-mode flip

resolution.note: setSandboxGame() re-renders the Actions panel on every sandbox-mode flip
